élite: Of high birth or social position; aristocratic or patrician.
émigré: An emigrant, one who departs their native land to become an immigrant in another, especially a political exile.
A French person who has departed their native land, especially a royalist who left during the French Revolution.
époisses: A traditional soft, pungent French cheese made from cows' milk.
épée: A sharp-pointed dueling sword with a bell-shaped guard, used (with the end blunted) in sport fencing.
études: Solo studies written by Chopin for the piano.
